correctness.rationale: The residual master-list stable matching is uniquely forced, so assignments of exceptions determine every remaining pair. A standard and explicitly applied womenwise join/meet identity upgrades the injective coordinate projection to an order/sub-lattice embedding; the dimension bound follows via k lexicographic extensions. The n-element chain for one exception and the Boolean products for k exceptions are proved stable for every size. Exact finite checks independently compare exhaustive stability and greedy completion but do not substitute for the proofs.

value.rationale: With one common admission-priority order except k full-list deviations, the theorem bounds the entire stable outcome space by (n)_k rather than a generic exponential family and gives a faithful k-coordinate distributive lattice with sharp dimensional examples. This is a natural tractability/representation boundary motivated by common-priority matching systems, not an isolated numerical census; no unjustified FPT claim is made.
